wanted: The featured variant shows item photos from the collection, but the contract only allows signature.media 'image' when the variant uses a media or gallery field, which price-list lacks. Signature is set to media 'none', which is not honest for the decision model; the contract needs a way to say 'shows item images'.

No price-list fixture has item images, so the browser gate never checks featured cards with photos (checked by hand at 1280 px only). Add images to the typical case or a requires-style rule for item images.
No way for a variant to require that some items have images, so featured can be chosen for a collection without photos; it then shows plain cards.
notes: Written by reusing the menu block's data and price code (copied, since blocks may only import the kit and their own files), so it passed first time. Group cards always stack price levels under each item, because cards are too narrow for columns side by side.
